channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about JR Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about JR Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Young on JR Smith
item.description:
Nick Young on JR Smith in Game 1:

“At the moment I didn't feel bad for him, I was wondering what was he doing? What is he doing? LeBron had 40 something, almost 50. He was cooking. And that was the main thing we was worried about. At the free throw line we thought, 'Oh man, it's over, we let one slip out.' And then when J.R. did that, it gave us hope again.”

Nick Young on JR Smith, Jun 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on JR Smith
item.description:
“Y'all see that clip of J.R. Smith talking about Delly. That sh*t is real…Just trying to be as disruptive as possible while guarding if not the best player in the world, the best player to ever shoot a basketball.”

De'Aaron Fox on JR Smith, Apr 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Frank Vogel on JR Smith
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Vogel on JR Smith:

“When you look at a guy who could potentially be out of the league and was a starter on a Finals team a couple years back, a champion, for him to have the perseverance to stay ready and give himself this opportunity, I think is to be commended.”

Frank Vogel on JR Smith, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: David Griffin on JR Smith
item.description:
David Griffin:

“So, I think to some degree, he shows up out of shape and then he gets injured getting himself in shape. And, so I hope what we see this year is a J.R. Smith that’s hellbent on proving something and shows up in shape. And if he does that and he doesn’t get injured, I think he’s still capable of playing high-level basketball. But he hasn’t been motivated to be that since he signed the deal, so you would have to say in that situation, the deal wasn’t the right deal, because it didn’t bring out the best in J.R.”

David Griffin on JR Smith, Sep 7, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on LeBron James, JR Smith
item.description:
said Cavaliers forward Kevin Love.

“Especially looking at [J.R. Smith] and Tristan [Thompson] and LeBron and myself, and the guys that have come and gone from our 2016 team and what we were able to do to overcome a 3-1 deficit [in the Finals], and how we were able to win those games. I think, yeah, that’s human nature to think about that kind of thing. But there’s been a lot of overhaul on this roster. We’ve mentioned all year. It’s felt like a number of seasons in one. But we’ve been resilient.”

Kyrie Irving on LeBron James, JR Smith, Jun 10, 2018. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Klay Thompson on JR Smith
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Klay Thompson on JR Smith's role in his injury:

“When I watched the replay, it pissed me off. That's a tough play on the ball,and just to tumble into somebody's legs like that... You gotta move past it, but it's life... It's just a minor setback. I don't think it was intentional.”

Klay Thompson on JR Smith, Jun 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: LeBron James on JR Smith
item.description:
LeBron James on whether J.R. Smith knew they were up one or tied:

“How do I know that? ... I knew it was a tie game... I thought we were all aware of what was going on... I don't know his state of mind.”

LeBron James on JR Smith, Jun 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Marcus Smart on JR Smith
item.description:
“I just looked at it, Al is a defenseless person. He’s in the air. He can’t control how his body goes, and he’s not even looking, and you go and take two hands to the back, that’s a dirty shot,”

Marcus Smart on JR Smith, May 16, 2018. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on JR Smith
item.description:
“For the most part, his effort is there every night. That's why I wanted to stick with JR Smith and I don't want to lose JR. Make sure keep him in good spirits, going in the right direction. He's big for us. When he's making shots, when he's being aggressive, our team is a whole different team.”

Tyronn Lue on JR Smith, Feb 12, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: LeBron James on JR Smith
item.description:
LeBron James was eating at a taco spot here in Central Florida when he saw Grambling State's Shakyla Hill recorded a quadruple double in a women's college basketball game this week.

“Me and Swish (J.R. Smith) was like 'holy sh...that's impressive,'”

LeBron James on JR Smith, Jan 6, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Kevin Love, JR Smith
item.description:
“No, it's two dudes that need the ball. LeBron needs the ball, Kyrie needs the ball, Kevin (Love) needs the ball. Swish (J.R. Smith) can't shoot unless he has the ball. Kyle Korver can't shoot unless he has the ball.”

Iman Shumpert on LeBron James, Kyle Korver, Kevin Love, JR Smith, Sep 15, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: David Griffin on JR Smith, Iman Shumpert
item.description:
Howard Beck:David Griffin:

“We got Iman Shumpert without giving up a first-round pick, because we were willing to take on JR Smith.”

David Griffin on JR Smith, Iman Shumpert, Mar 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @HowardBeck.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on JR Smith
item.description:
Michael Lee:Kyrie Irving on if JR Smith has found a shirt yet:

“No. I don’t think he should. Let him celebrate how he wants, he’s a championship winner”

Kyrie Irving on JR Smith, Jun 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on JR Smith, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Rick Noland:Tyronn Lue:

“They're playing JR Smith like we're playing Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson.”

Tyronn Lue on JR Smith, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jun 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on JR Smith, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
“Kyrie [Irving], when we get a chance, Kevin, when we get a chance, J.R. [Smith] when we get a chance.”

Tyronn Lue on JR Smith, Kyrie Irving, Mar 4, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jae Crowder on JR Smith
item.description:
Jay King:Jae Crowder on JR Smith:

“I hope he apologizes tomorrow. But if he doesn't, we'll play ball.”

Jae Crowder on JR Smith, Dec 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: David Griffin on JR Smith, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
David Griffin on the free agency of J.R. Smith and Matthew Dellavedova:

“We’d like to bring both of them back if it can be worked out. In Delly’s case the restricted free agency is a totally different process. With J.R. … he’s a player I’d like to have back. We just have to find a way to make it work.”

David Griffin on JR Smith, Matthew Dellavedova, Jul 13, 2015. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: LeBron James on JR Smith
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:LeBron James on J.R. Smith:

“I don't want his head to be down like it was Thursday. ... He has to stay confident. He can take 100 shots.”

LeBron James on JR Smith, Jun 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: David Blatt on JR Smith
item.description:
“I have no idea and I really can’t comment on anything in the past, but I can tell you one thing: J.R. Smith has been a dream for us, as a team and for me personally,”

David Blatt on JR Smith, Feb 22, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: LeBron James on JR Smith
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:LeBron on J.R.:

“There’s only a few guys in our league that have unconscious levels about shooting the ball, and J.R. Smith is one of them.”

LeBron James on JR Smith, Apr 6, 2014. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Mike Woodson on JR Smith
item.description:
Chris Herring:Mike Woodson, on ESPN radio, says

“I think the JR [Smith suspension] really put us behind early on; I really do.”

Mike Woodson on JR Smith, Mar 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on JR Smith
item.description:
“I told you guys the other day, we need J.R. Smith. We need him to play the way he played [Friday]. I thought he played extremely well and we’re going to need more of that.”

Carmelo Anthony on JR Smith, Jan 18, 2014. Source: New York Post.

item.title: George Karl on JR Smith
item.description:
Smith was a free agent over the summer and signed a three-year, $18 million contract with theKnicks.

“I know San Antonio has always liked J.R. Smith and I know they've thought about bringing him in,”

George Karl on JR Smith, Jan 9, 2014. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Shane Battier on JR Smith
item.description:
Chris Herring:Battier, on whether JR Smith has ever tried untying his shoe:

“Not that I know of. And if he did, I might decide its time to [retire.]”

Shane Battier on JR Smith, Jan 9, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: Mike Woodson on JR Smith
item.description:
Chris Herring:Woodson, on ESPN radio abt JR Smith:

“Its unacceptable. It really is. Its unprofessional. Thats the only word I can use. Just cannot do it.”

Mike Woodson on JR Smith, Jan 8, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Doc Rivers, JR Smith
item.description:
“People who came out and pay their hard-earned money to watch us play, we had some tough years. They should be enjoying this.’’Boston coach Doc Rivers fumed about the Smith elbow, saying he wished he was “still a player’’ so he could settled the score. The NBA may not have wanted Smith on the parquet today for fear of a potential rhubarb. “He’s handled it the right way,”

Mike Woodson on Doc Rivers, JR Smith, Apr 28, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on JR Smith
item.description:
Howard Beck:Kenyon on JR Smith:

“I don’t know what he’s eating for breakfast or dinner or whatever it is, but we need him to keep doing it.”

Kenyon Martin on JR Smith, Mar 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @HowardBeckNYT.
